assessment_scope: Complete pinned Level 1 identifier inventory; selected requirements traced to scoped observations and existing regression scenarios. No complete ASVS compliance assessment.

chapters.scope: C/JSON, SQL/BSON and frontend output contexts; XML is not an application input parser.
Server validators and application workflows; input/flow inventory remains incomplete.
Browser rendering, cookies, security headers and CSRF across the complete origin.
HTTP JSON API and static routing; no application WebSocket endpoint.
Attachments, imports, exports and backup/recovery archive boundaries.
OpenBoard passwords/bootstrap and the separate NPM administration authentication surface.
OpenBoard reference sessions; NPM session/token behavior requires separate assessment.
Global/board roles, personal resources and ancestry; SaaS tenant separation is absent.
OpenBoard does not use self-contained sessions; NPM administration token implementation is unassessed.
No OpenBoard OAuth/OIDC integration; full upstream/proxy provider applicability remains unassessed.
Application hashing/randomness and optional backup encryption; upstream crypto/key inventory incomplete.
Public TLS is operator configured; internal connections are unencrypted in supplied Compose.
Build/runtime configuration, environment files, selected runtime assets and effective port/routing policy.
Credential/data placement, browser drafts, exports, logs and private snapshot custody.
Dependency management, safe coding, typed input, concurrency and availability boundaries.
Application/proxy/database logs and errors; protected security-event collection is incomplete.
No application WebRTC functionality; revisit if a media/realtime integration is added.

controls.observation: Frontend escapes text/attributes, restricts rendered reference protocols and uses local scripts. JSON response construction escapes strings.
controls.remaining_work: Review every output context and exercise actual browsers; VM assertions cover selected sinks only.

controls.observation: Application values use prepared SQLite statements; the cloud adapter binds SQL data and converts supported JSON to literal typed BSON.
controls.remaining_work: Review all current and future queries, dynamic identifier allowlists and raw database clients; named tests are selected injection/type scenarios.

controls.observation: Operational scripts use subprocess argument vectors; the domain API does not provide an OS command execution endpoint.
controls.remaining_work: Audit every command invocation, argument interpretation and tool override; safe archive extraction alone does not prove command-injection resistance.

controls.observation: Application JavaScript is supplied as static local assets; CSP excludes unsafe-eval.
controls.remaining_work: Review all dynamic execution sites in application, proxy and dependencies; the test verifies static response policy rather than every interpreter.

controls.observation: The OpenBoard API/importers accept JSON or CSV and do not parse user XML; opaque uploaded attachments are downloaded as files. This statement does not assess PostgreSQL XML or every NPM dependency.
controls.remaining_work: Reassess if XML/SAML/SVG parsing is introduced; independently review XML-capable upstream components when assessing the full stack.

controls.observation: Documented typed bounds are enforced by backend validators and transaction logic; frontend checks improve feedback.
controls.remaining_work: Complete an endpoint/field inventory and verify all security/business inputs against the documented contract; fuzzing does not establish exhaustive validation.

controls.observation: Review votes, invalidation and domain mutations are transactional; material edits invalidate approval.
controls.remaining_work: Assess every business flow and forbidden step transition. Existing approvals do not automatically enforce a completion gate.

controls.observation: API replies use JSON UTF-8 and nosniff; file exports/downloads use attachment disposition. Static frontend serves an explicit asset set.
controls.remaining_work: Review every response type and direct-navigation context, including attachment MIME handling and error responses in the complete proxy chain.

controls.observation: HTTPS origins add Secure to the HttpOnly/SameSite Strict ob_session cookie; its name has no required security prefix. Local HTTP intentionally omits Secure.
controls.remaining_work: Design and migrate to an appropriate __Host-/__Secure- cookie for HTTPS, handle old cookies/duplicate names and test actual browsers. Local evaluation cannot satisfy this public deployment property.

controls.observation: The shipped frontend/API security headers do not guarantee HSTS on every public response.
controls.remaining_work: Define a production HSTS policy after validating HTTPS and domain/subdomain ownership, enforce it at ingress and verify all response classes. A redirect test is not an HSTS test.

controls.observation: Exact Host/Origin checks and authenticated-write CSRF tokens protect the same-origin API; domain mutations use modifying methods.
controls.remaining_work: Inventory all endpoints, aliases, public bootstrap capabilities and proxy error responses; test CORS policy and safe-method side effects comprehensively.

controls.observation: OpenBoard currently polls HTTP APIs and exposes no application WebSocket endpoint.
controls.remaining_work: Reassess before adding realtime WebSockets or another upstream service with WebSocket routing.

controls.observation: HTTP/file/card limits and retained-file admission bound selected resources. Files are database payloads downloaded through authorized APIs. Backup extraction rejects unsafe paths/types.
controls.remaining_work: Measure process memory/physical external storage and all generated filesystem paths; do not infer antivirus or complete DoS resistance from logical quotas.

controls.observation: Attachments have metadata/size validation and attachment disposition, but no general extension-to-magic/content validation or antivirus scanner.
controls.remaining_work: Classify supported file uses and implement suitable content validation/quarantine where needed; downloads can still harm recipient devices.

controls.observation: SECURITY.md records backend fixed-window quotas and nginx/NPM limits; regressions check trusted identity, isolation, expiry and concurrent reservations.
controls.remaining_work: Distributed authentication quotas and adaptive anti-abuse remain absent. Review backend replicas, IPv6/network aggregation and perimeter capacity.

controls.observation: The backend requires valid UTF-8 passwords of 12 to 256 bytes. This is a byte rule, not a minimum Unicode character-count rule.
controls.remaining_work: Adopt and test a character-count policy consistent with the chosen authentication assurance; 12 UTF-8 bytes can represent fewer than eight characters.

controls.observation: Users can change passwords using current/new values; backend preserves UTF-8 bytes without composition rules or case transformation. Other sessions are revoked on success.
controls.remaining_work: Review all setup/admin/password paths, Unicode edge cases and exact-byte handling; assess current-token rotation separately.

controls.observation: No common-password or breached-password blocklist is consulted at setup, user creation or password change.
controls.remaining_work: Add a maintained local blocklist compatible with the password policy, without transmitting submitted passwords to an external service.

controls.observation: Frontend password controls mask entry and do not intentionally block paste or password managers.
controls.remaining_work: Run real-browser keyboard, paste, autocomplete and password-manager checks for every authentication/password control.

controls.observation: The app ships without seeded accounts; private bootstrap generates distinct random administrator passwords rather than shared defaults.
controls.remaining_work: Generated bootstrap passwords do not expire or require first-use replacement. Evaluate initial-secret lifecycle and all upstream default accounts before public service.

controls.observation: OpenBoard has no password-hint or knowledge-question recovery flow.
controls.remaining_work: Review upstream NPM recovery behavior separately and preserve this restriction when account recovery is introduced.

controls.observation: Backend verifies dynamically generated 256-bit reference tokens using stored SHA-256 hashes and current active-account/session state.
controls.remaining_work: Review RNG failure paths, token handling across all consumers and upstream NPM tokens; statistical or fixture checks do not establish entropy by themselves.

controls.observation: Login issues a fresh token but does not generally revoke the caller existing session. Password change retains the current token while revoking other sessions.
controls.remaining_work: Design session rotation on authentication/reauthentication and sensitive factor changes without breaking explicit multi-device sessions; add fixation/reuse regressions.

controls.observation: Logout, deactivation and idle/absolute expiry prevent subsequent backend use. Protected writes recheck after lock waits.
controls.remaining_work: Assess every mutation/replay/replica path and document the timeout risk decision for the target deployment; no federated-session claim applies.

controls.observation: Backend function/data ACLs, ownership/live ancestry and transactional authorization cover protected writes and cached domain replay.
controls.remaining_work: Keep a route/action/role inventory and test negative cases for new aliases/replay families; selected TOCTOU regressions do not assess every race.

controls.observation: Board ACLs operate within one installation; global administrators can read all boards. No workspace/SaaS tenant boundary is implemented.
controls.remaining_work: Implement an explicit tenant model and cross-tenant controls before promising SaaS tenant isolation. Board membership tests cannot substitute for this design.

controls.observation: Backend uses OpenSSL PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, SHA-256, RAND_bytes and constant-time password comparison. Optional backup encryption uses OpenSSL CMS AES-256-GCM with RSA-OAEP.
controls.remaining_work: Maintain a complete crypto/key inventory and review upstream TLS/token implementations, parameter upgrades and key custody. Optional backup encryption does not encrypt live databases or every export.

controls.observation: Public access requires an exact HTTPS origin, trusted certificate and exact redirect. Preflight verifies the certificate using public-hostname SNI through loopback.
controls.remaining_work: Operator must supply actual TLS configuration and runtime evidence for the exact deployment; test enabled protocol/cipher policy, all ingress paths and renewal. Local HTTP is evaluation only.

controls.observation: The supplied Docker networks isolate services, but internal API and database connections do not configure transport encryption.
controls.remaining_work: Design authenticated internal TLS and trust/key rotation if the deployment requires protection against host/network peers; private networking is not cryptography.

controls.observation: Runtime images copy selected binaries/assets; static routes allow only explicit public files. Git/environment/build exclusions protect the build context.
controls.remaining_work: Inspect each final release filesystem/layer and effective web routing; a source recipe or one frontend test is not a complete artifact inspection.

controls.observation: Sessions use cookies and CSRF uses a request header; passwords and submitted domain data use request bodies.
controls.remaining_work: Review all URL parameters, referrers and ingress logs. Search queries can contain sensitive project terms even without credentials.

controls.observation: Logout/account changes clear visible authenticated state and reject late responses, but account-scoped recovery drafts intentionally remain in browser storage.
controls.remaining_work: Define and implement an explicit secure erasure/retention policy for DOM, drafts, caches and downloads appropriate to shared profiles; current isolation is not complete storage erasure.

controls.observation: The project tracks pinned inputs and dated dependency findings but has no documented risk-based dependency remediation deadlines or complete current artifact assessment.
controls.remaining_work: Agree realistic risk-based update/remediation time frames and triage exact candidate image findings. Existing best-effort support and old scan counts do not satisfy these requirements.

controls.observation: Account responses select public account fields; domain endpoints use shaped JSON responses and ACL-filtered summaries rather than exposing raw database tables.
controls.remaining_work: Inventory every endpoint/schema and every response field, especially administrative exports, summaries, personal resources and diagnostic errors.

controls.observation: The exact trusted peer may supply one canonical numeric client address; NPM replaces incoming identity headers with the TCP client address.
controls.remaining_work: Validate the full running ingress chain after any proxy/CDN/topology change; distributed NAT/VPN users can still share an address.

controls.observation: Custom-field merge/planning lookups check own properties, including legitimate constructor/prototype keys.
controls.remaining_work: Review all JavaScript object merges, imported JSON and transitive proxy dependencies; selected special-key regressions are not a whole-program prototype-pollution audit.

controls.observation: Request logs escape paths and omit bodies/tokens; telemetry uses bounded fixed labels. Configuration and persistence failures return sanitized errors, roll back and invalidate failed cache state.
controls.remaining_work: Review all log layers, query-string exposure, proxy/driver diagnostics, failure modes and remote log protection. Add a complete security-event inventory and protected audit/alert channel.
